agent_invocation_lease_check.name: agent_invocation_lease_check
agent_invocation_lease_check.value: ("agent_invocation"."status" in ('leased','running')) = ("agent_invocation"."worker_id" is not null and "agent_invocation"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

bootstrap_proposal_decision_check.name: bootstrap_proposal_decision_check
bootstrap_proposal_decision_check.value: ("automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decision_request" is null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decision_idempotency_key" is null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decided_by_user_id" is null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decided_at" is null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."status" not in ('approved','declined')) or ("automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decision_request" is not null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decision_idempotency_key" is not null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."decided_at" is not null and "automation_bootstrap_proposal"."status" in ('approved','declined','canceled'))

automation_bootstrap_bounds_check.name: automation_bootstrap_bounds_check
automation_bootstrap_bounds_check.value: "automation_bootstrap"."member_count" between 0 and 1000 and "automation_bootstrap"."group_size" between 1 and 25 and "automation_bootstrap"."publication_boundary" >= 0

automation_proposal_revision_check.name: automation_proposal_revision_check
automation_proposal_revision_check.value: ("automation_proposal"."status" = 'approved') = ("automation_proposal"."activated_revision" is not null) and ("automation_proposal"."activated_revision" is null or "automation_proposal"."activated_revision" > 0)

automation_proposal_decision_check.name: automation_proposal_decision_check
automation_proposal_decision_check.value: ("automation_proposal"."decision_request" is null and "automation_proposal"."decision_idempotency_key" is null and "automation_proposal"."decided_by_user_id" is null and "automation_proposal"."decided_at" is null and "automation_proposal"."status" not in ('approved','declined')) or ("automation_proposal"."decision_request" is not null and "automation_proposal"."decision_idempotency_key" is not null and "automation_proposal"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "automation_proposal"."decided_at" is not null and "automation_proposal"."status" in ('approved','declined','canceled'))

data_access_request_decision_check.name: data_access_request_decision_check
data_access_request_decision_check.value: ("data_access_request"."status" in ('approved','declined')) = ("data_access_request"."decision_request" is not null and "data_access_request"."decision_idempotency_key" is not null and "data_access_request"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "data_access_request"."decided_at" is not null)

terminal_session_thread_active_unique_id.name: terminal_session_thread_active_unique_idx
terminal_session_thread_active_unique_id.where: "terminal_session"."thread_id" is not null and "terminal_session"."closed_at" is null
